messages:
Eden Park: Quick sync: finalizing run-of-show for the Apr webinar. Need firm timing for speaker intros and the live Q&A block.
Ravi Nair: Proposed: intro 5m, product demo A 12m, demo B 8m, customer story 7m, Q&A 18m, wrap 5m. Total 55m + 5m buffer.
Sofia Torres: That looks good. Can we swap demo order so the heavier, interactive demo goes second? Audience stays for the narrative arc.
Eden Park: Swap OK. Marco you confirmed the customer speaker can join at 10:40 PT?
Marco Silva: Confirmed. They arrive at 10:30 PT. Will do a 10m pre-call to test audio.
Sofia Torres: For rehearsal schedule: full run at 08:45 PT, mic checks at 08:30. Please have slides + demo tokens loaded by 08:15.
Ravi Nair: Demo tokens: sending ephemeral creds to the webinar-test acct. Note: rehearsal endpoints are rate-limited to 250 req/min. Avoid long loops.
Marco Silva: Can we get a short script for the host handoff? E.g., "Now handing to Marco for the customer story" with on-screen lower-third?
Eden Park: Yes. Host script will be posted to the shared doc. Include exact phrasing for slide transitions.
Sofia Torres: Red-team checklist: fallback model = redwood-dedicated-1q; healthcheck interval 10s; automated routing policy for failover. Jasper from infra please confirm rollback TTL.
Marco Silva: OpsBot, create alert: channel=#temp-alerts, rule=webinar-demo-latency>700ms, notify=@marketing @eng-oncall
OpsBot: Alert rule created (id: ar_20260322_01)
Ravi Nair: For recording: capture separate tracks, and also save raw chat log. We'll need the chat for follow-up mail merge.
Eden Park: Post-webinar assets: 1) short highlight reel (2m), 2) full recording, 3) transcript + timestamps, 4) slides + code snippets. Assign owners in doc.
Sofia Torres: Quick note on audience routing: inbound interest form should point to /webinars/2026-04-followup with utm=webinar_apr. Ops to wire up.
Marco Silva: I added the run-of-show with new demo order to the doc. Please review before 6pm PT.
Ravi Nair: Rehearsal prompt set attached in drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/rls/webinar_prompt_pack. Use model params: temp=0.2, max_tokens=512 for demos.
Eden Park: Thank you all. Final cue sheet due in #marketing by 6pm PT and copy to #temp-alerts. Good practice run today 08:45 PT.
